product.descriptionHtml:
The Travel Tumbler TT-400 is a double-wall vacuum-insulated coffee tumbler made for US commuters and remote workers who need reliable heat on the go.

Why It Keeps Coffee Better

  • Ceramic-coated interior preserves coffee taste without metallic notes.
  • Keeps coffee hot for 6 hours and drinks cold for 12 hours.
  • Natural bamboo lid with slide closure stays secure and fits most car cup holders.

Key Specs

400 ml capacity in 18/8 stainless steel, double-wall vacuum-insulated construction, priced at 26 USD.

Perfect for Your Day

Ideal for US commuters and remote workers drinking coffee while traveling or working away from a desk.

Answers to Everyday Tumbler Frustrations

The ceramic coating and vacuum insulation address metallic taste and rapid heat loss, while the bamboo slide lid and cup-holder fit solve leaking lids and poor vehicle compatibility.

Simple Care

Hand-wash only to keep the finish and lid in top condition.
